title: BetterSunflowers
description: I made Sunflowers more beautifull. Its pretty cool.
body:
This Rsource Pack makes Sunflowers more beautifull. I try to make it look as Minecraft like as posible. These Textures are Part of [Green Texturepack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/green-texturepack) you can check it out if you want. You are free to use the textures however and wherever you want.

The sunfloweres aren't really to scale but I hope thats ok.

_I probably won't update this texturepack since there really isn't much to update._
